animation_description: In the animation: her long wavy hair sways softly, snow falls slowly outside the windows, the Christmas tree lights and the glowing gold star topper twinkle, the fairy lights in the arched hallway shimmer, the candles on the dining table flicker, and the glitter on the gold and champagne sequin dresses sparkles, while the teepee tree's lights glow warmly. The grain and brushstroke texture of the illustration is preserved all the way through — never smoothed out, never recolored.
note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 37K-like reel, posted Nov 20, gets ready for the L'Oréal Paris Women of Worth gala in a gold sequin 'Life of the Party Sequin Midi Dress' from Shop Akira — outside her comfort zone — and puts it to a vote: classic black bag and heels, or forest green bag with matching green jewelry. Commenters overwhelmingly pick green for the Christmas vibe, with Nuxe shimmering body oil and Balmain perfume finishing the glow. A 20K-like H&M holiday haul models eight looks — a burgundy sequined pleated maxi skirt with a matching turtleneck, a black long-sleeve lace mini dress with bow details, a sleeveless light-blue floral brocade mini, a black mini dress with a large white bow at the neck, a black lace maxi with a deep V-neck and ruffled hem, a black strapless fit-and-flare mini with an embellished bodice, a strapless green-and-black floral mini, and a sleeveless brown velvet mini. A 13K-like Bella Barnett try-on runs four holiday dresses — a shimmering gold metallic bandage maxi that cinches the waist, a short gold sequin mesh mini she calls a 'Beyonce freakum dress,' and a navy blue feathered mini with vintage 1950s vibes. A 13K-like 'festive outfits for EVERYbody' showcase has Lottie (size 14) and Laura (size 24) modelling five coordinated looks side by side — matching black sequined feather-hem mini dresses, light blue shirts with silver sequin skirts, black-and-white ballgowns with pearl-detailed bodices, burgundy velvet mini dresses, and black long-sleeve tops with black sequin maxi skirts. A 10K-like reel, posted today, pairs two women in matching-style sequined maxi dresses with fringe hems — a deep red sleeveless gown and a champagne one with an open lace-up back. An 8.5K-like reel runs seven all-black holiday outfits — a black satin sleeveless top with a sheer sequined midi skirt, a black long-sleeve top with sequined shorts and black tights, an oversized black turtleneck over a sheer black tulle maxi skirt, a black velvet sequined wrap pantsuit, a black top with a feathered collar and satin midi skirt, a sheer black lace mini layered over a bralette and shorts, and a black sequin long-sleeve mini with tights. A 7.3K-like reel with 14K comments styles 'the perfect little holiday outfit' — a black bodysuit under a sheer black pearl-embellished top with a silver sequined midi skirt with a front slit, a small black feathered handbag with a pearl handle, and metallic pointed-toe heels. A 7.5K-like Christmas party outfit haul holds up a red sequin slip dress, a burgundy strapless sequin mini, a burgundy halter ruched dress, leopard-print flared pants, a burgundy lace midi skirt and matching top, a black sequin long-sleeve mini, black sequin flared pants, a red velvet long-sleeve mini, leopard-print knee-high stiletto boots, black sequin shorts, and a burgundy zip-up jacket.
trends.title: Gold sequins win the gala vote, all-black holiday looks, and matching fringe maxis

trends.details: A 210K-like reel fixes a tree that is 'too dark' with a light-up gold star tree topper — climbing a step ladder, breaking an ornament on the way, and switching on the glowing star at the peak. A 110K-like reel has a mum and daughter build a teepee-style Christmas tree — three wooden poles tied at the top, green garland wrapped around the frame, warm white string lights, a large red velvet bow topper and red-and-green ornaments — with a cozy movie-night nook tucked inside, red gingerbread blankets and a peppermint-swirl pillow. A 74K-like reel builds a flat wall tree from black-and-silver tinsel garland shaped into stacked triangles, hung with rolled-fabric candy cane ornaments in five colours, a large red-and-silver glitter bow on top, warm white fairy lights woven through, and plush Santas at the base. A 54K-like reel answers 'you have enough twinkle lights' by stringing even more across an arched hallway — a canopy of fairy lights over greenery garlands, red ribbons, dried orange slices, large paper stars, and red-and-gold star lanterns. A 23K-like reel counts down as a family at twilight and thousands of warm white Christmas lights switch on at once — wrapped around tree trunks, draped from branches, outlining the roofline and columns — in drone and ground shots. A 19K-like reel sets a formal Christmas table — an evergreen garland runner, black woven placemats, layered white and gold-rimmed plates, white napkins tied with red berry sprigs and wooden reindeer name holders, a small lit tree as centrepiece, tall white candles in gold holders, miniature bottle-brush trees, pinecones, and gold crackers — joking the table 'nearly ended my 15 year relationship.' An 18K-like reel makes a flat wall tree on a sage-green corner wall — adhesive hooks in a zigzag triangle, warm white fairy lights for the outline, thick green tinsel garland for foliage, a gold star topper, red, silver, and gold baubles, and knitted stockings hung beside it. A 2.4K-like tour, posted today, walks a home dressed with dried orange slice ornaments — greenery garlands, wreaths, and small trees with dried oranges, fairy lights, and small wooden stars — including a tree decorated solely with dried oranges, with a quick demo of how the orange slices are made.
trends.title: A light-up star topper rescue, a teepee tree with a movie nook, and walls of twinkle lights

trends.details: A 1.7K-like tutorial, posted today, paints a candy-cane graphic eye — deep red and pink shadow in the crease, shimmery light pink on the lid, a bold white graphic wing above the crease, red-and-white diagonal stripes along the wing's lower edge, small pearls near the inner brow, and false lashes. A 2K-like 'holiday party eye' tutorial, posted today, works through the Prada Beauty eyeshadow palette — a base shade on the lid, depth built in, a darker shade on the outer corner and lower lash line, Prada eyeliner on the waterline and upper lash line, a shimmery highlight at the inner corner and centre of the lid, and Prada mascara. A 5.7K-like tutorial builds an elaborate pink-red gradient eye — a white base on the inner lid, brown for depth, and small clear rhinestones along the lower lash line near the outer corner, finished with a shimmery gold lid. A 710-like reel demos the ColourPop x Disney 'A Very Mickey Christmas' collection — a 12-shade palette of pinks, purples, silvers, and glitters, the Jelly Much Eyeshadow Stick in 'T' Heat' patted on for silver sparkle, and the Glitterally Obsessed liquid liner duo. A 2.4K-like 'sparkly icy makeup' tutorial layers white and silver eyeshadow, heavy pink blush, glossy lips, and iridescent glitter dots under the eyes like ice crystals, worn with a fluffy white fur hat and coat. A 560-like 'Christmas Glam' reel swatches MOIRA's Endless Glitz eyeshadows — 'Emerald Mirage,' 'Moonlit Allure,' and 'Gilded Muse' glitter palettes — with gloss lipsticks in 'Caramel Luster' and 'Cherry Stardust.' A 2.8K-like 'Christmas glow' tutorial builds liquid highlighter and cream blush, a matte brown crease with a shimmery gold lid, winged liner, and a bright pink-red lipstick topped with glossy red gloss. A 4.6K-like Natasha Denona tutorial creates a warm glowing glam — matte 'soft spot' in the crease, shimmery 'fancy' on the lid, darker 'pep' and 'shover' along the lash line, HY-GEN serum primer, foundation, liquid bronzer and contour, cream blush, and a nude lip with gloss.
trends.title: Candy-cane graphic liner, icy sparkle, and glitter palettes for Christmas glam
